card.name: The word immune-mediated in warnings
card.fires_on: The word "mediated" (or the hyphen plus "mediated") completing "immune-mediated" before "adverse reactions" in immune checkpoint inhibitor labels. Also seen in "Toxicity" after a body-system heading.
